title: Fill-in-the-Blank Drunk Tank
tagline: Because charades is *so* last Tuesday. Need a way to liven up that awkward family reunion where everyone pretends to like your new vegan cheese wheel? Unleash the Mad Libs. Just try not to let Uncle Jerry fill in 'body cavity' for every noun. May spontaneously combust from forced hilarity.

title: Egg-cellent Headwear, Indeed.
tagline: So, you're staging an avant-garde production of nursery rhymes, and Humpty Dumpty *absolutely* refuses to emerge from his shell without proper royal attire? We get it. This crown is the only thing separating a successful performance from total yolk-induced chaos. Audience members will understand *exactly* your artistic vision.

title: Perpetual Pun-ishment Calendar
tagline: For the individual who unironically enjoys being the family's comedic black sheep. Stuck in a silent retreat and desperately need to break the tension with a well-timed (or terribly mistimed) gag about parallel lines? This calendar is your alibi. At least you can blame the bad joke on the date.

title: Currency Chaos Organizers
tagline: Returning from that vaguely-legal international scavenger hunt? Now you can meticulously sort your ill-gotten gains. Forget dumping it all in a jar; these bags whisper, "I have standards," even when dealing with slightly-melted Euros found behind a kebab stand.

title: Fake It 'Til You Make...
tagline: Still haven't mastered the art of appearing like a functional human? This little guide offers helpful tips like 'pay your bills' and 'eat vegetables'. Perfect for that friend who insists on ordering pizza *before* splitting the dinner bill. At least now they have no excuse.

title: Therapy? Nah, Try This!
tagline: Date night getting stale? Spice things up with... structured communication. Forget actually talking; now you can compete for who's 'right' according to pre-approved questions. Perfect for couples who secretly yearn for the structured drama of a corporate team-building exercise, but, you know, at home.

title: Ruin Friendships, One Card
tagline: So, you've decided your liver isn't suffering enough? This King's Cup game will ensure maximum regret by 2 AM. Imagine: Chad from accounting, surprisingly good at remembering rules after six White Claws, forcing you to chug lukewarm beer. Congratulations, you've unlocked a new level of self-loathing, all for the price of a slightly overpriced deck of cards. Enjoy being broke AND hungover!

title: Dysfunctional Family Therapy, Boxed
tagline: Because sometimes you need a card game to remind you that your relatives aren't *that* insane. Perfect for awkward holiday gatherings where everyone's already three sheets to the wind and arguing about politics. At least this way, the insanity is structured and (hopefully) less scarring.

title: Birthday in a Card
tagline: For the friend who's impossible to shop for, this card says it all. Literally, it just says 'it's your birthday'. Use it when you've forgotten someone's special day and need a last-minute save.

title: Ladies Kick Butt
tagline: For the woman who's tired of saving the world from her couch, this book is a reminder that others have done it too, in better outfits. Imagine reading about Wonder Woman while eating cereal, feeling inspired to maybe do laundry today.

title: Key Holder of Chaos
tagline: For when you're already running late and can't find your keys, this buckle key holder is the perfect addition to your frantic morning routine, because what's a little more stress?

title: Keychain for the Truly Discerning
tagline: For when you need to add some heft to your keys, but not so much that you can't still fit them in your pocket, this slim keychain is the answer to a question you never knew you had, until now.

title: Cards for the Truly Alone
tagline: For when you're stuck in a hotel room with no Wi-Fi, these vintage playing cards will be your only friend, judging you silently as you play solitaire for hours on end.

title: Shred in Decor
tagline: For the aunt who still thinks she's a groupie, this vintage guitar poster is a great way to decorate her basement bar, where she'll be playing air guitar to 80s rock ballads alone on Friday nights.

title: Key Ring Chaos Solver
tagline: For when you've got 17 keys and a bad memory, this split key ring is a lifesaver - or at least a sanity-saver - for the chronically disorganized.
